ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure marks the epicenter positions of the two earthquakes and major plate boundaries. The epicenter of the Haiti earthquake is located near Haiti in the Caribbean Sea, close to a plate junction zone; the epicenter of the Chile earthquake is located near Chile on the west coast of South America, also close to a plate junction zone. Then reason: Both strong earthquakes occurred near plate boundaries and are earthquakes caused by plate tectonic activity. The fundamental driving force of plate motion and earthquake energy release mainly comes from inside the Earth.
